limits: Request charges are visible recorded charges, not an invoice or a complete provider counter.
Unobserved SDK calls, some canary CRUD and cleanup, storage, hosting, bandwidth and model charges are not included.
Dollar arithmetic uses the planning rate, not a verified account-specific price.

timing.mtimeClockLimit: Start and end are filesystem timestamp observations, not provider execution timestamps.

matchedControlQuestion.limits: This compares the application-filtered request with E59's id-only global control, not a pure filter-only toggle.
